description: Calculates Korean regional insurance premiums and preliminary income/property flags only. dependentEligibility.isEligible is null: family support, spouse/sibling conditions, housing rental income and statutory exceptions require NHIS review.

hasBusinessRegistration.description: Whether registered as a business owner

hasHousingRentalIncome.description: Business income includes housing rental income (treated as registered even without registration)

isDisabledOrMerit.description: Registered disabled person, national merit or veteran-compensation wounded (business income up to 5M allowed regardless of registration)

isMarried.description: Candidate is married (both spouses must meet the income test)

otherIncome.description: Other annual income (근로/연금 등) in KRW

propertyTaxBase.description: Property tax base (재산세 과세표준) in KRW

relationship.description: Candidate's relationship to the employee (default unknown)

siblingUnmarried.description: Sibling is unmarried (divorced/widowed counts as unmarried)

spouseMeetsIncomeCriteria.description: For a married candidate: spouse also meets the income test
